source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

From now on, each iteration must carry forward every design decision we have already locked.

The Hero V and second V are currently working. I also asked for the É accent to be a literal copy/paste of the Hero V termination, and that relationship needs to remain intact throughout every future iteration.

These concepts do not contain all the architectural relationships we previously established, so I’m unable to evaluate the E and L ideas in a meaningful way.

I’m not seeking standalone examples of E and L letterforms. I need to see complete wordmarks in which every component shares one design language. Because the E and L belong to the same system as the Hero V, second V, and É accent, they cannot be developed separately from those elements.

I also want us to use our time carefully. As the project progresses, every revision should extend the prior version rather than discarding decisions that have already been made. This will let us assess a single variable at a time and ensure that each feedback round is productive.

If required to select among these concepts, I would probably choose option 3. For the next concepts, please show complete wordmarks that include all elements approved previously.
